title: Morocco's Economy Grows 5.2% — Bank Al-Maghrib Raises 2026 Forecast
body:
Bank Al-Maghrib (BAM) has raised its 2026 GDP growth forecast to 5.2%, making Morocco one of the fastest-growing economies in the MENA region. The revision reflects record tourism revenues, agricultural recovery, and World Cup infrastructure spending.

Inflation Under Control

Inflation eased to 1.2% in May 2026. The central bank held its key rate steady at 2.75%. The Marrakech-Safi region is projected to outperform the national average at 6.1% growth.

Based on Bank Al-Maghrib quarterly monetary policy report, June 2026.
